aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:658.title: Guest Services Staff - Usher/Ticket Taker- AEG Presents Great Lakes -  Royal Oak Music Theater
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:658.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! GUEST SERVICES - USHER/TICKET TAKER SUMMARY Guest Services Staff will act as the primary provider of direct services to guests when they are inside the venue. They are responsible for providing a safe environment for all guests beginning the moment they enter the facility. The incumbent will provide a variety of customer service duties on behalf of the venue for its guests, in an expert, professional and friendly manner. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES Answer guest questions, direct guests to important areas of the venue (restrooms, ATM, coat checks, VIP areas, and concert area) and provide additional assistance whenever necessary. Operate the various coat check rooms within established guidelines and procedures at the venue. Scan tickets for entry into the venue, administer applicable wristbands for event entrance (21+, VIP Access, Private Event Access). Greet guests and resolve guest complaints, escalating concerns as necessary. Seat guests and assist ADA patrons. Enforce all policies and procedures of the venue. Complete all company and venue required trainings. Act as a member of the emergency evacuation team by communicating with and directing guests during a facility emergency. Monitor venue during guest arrival and exit to comply with fire department safety regulations. Perform other duties and responsibilities as deemed appropriate by Management and Supervisors. QUALIFICATIONS A minimum education level of: High School Diploma or its equivalency Previous experience preferred, but not required Reliable, punctual, and regular in attendance Ability to work in a loud and fast paced environment Ability to de-escalate tense situations Ability to work in varying conditions Ability to lift 50 lbs. without assistance Excellent interpersonal and communication skills Positive attitude with superior customer service skills, and be team oriented Ability to stand, walk, and climb stairs for long periods of time Strong intrapersonal skills with an outgoing, friendly personality Strong listening and verbal communication skills Availability to work various hours: nights, weekends, and holidays as required. PREFERENCES Previous experience working in events and knowledge of the music industry preferred Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed according to venue schedule Payscale: $10 - $25 Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Part-time: This position may be eligible for benefits (ACA qualification). AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside his/her normal description.

aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:9c3f69f7-.company: Pre-Seed Series a Series b Series c Series D Series E IPO Gamma AI Build beautiful presentations with generative AI. Bay Area
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:9c3f69f7-.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Gamma is used by millions of people every day to create, teach, and persuade. But our brand is just getting started. As Creative Director, you'll build and lead Gamma's creative function while staying deeply hands-on as a designer yourself. Your mandate is to take Gamma's brand from beloved prosumer tool to a platform trusted by Fortune 100 companies and solo creators alike. With 80% of our users outside the United States, you'll own how Gamma translates across cultures, languages, and business contexts, ensuring the brand resonates everywhere without losing its personality. You'll manage and grow a distributed design team, collaborate closely with a creative team of marketers, and bring cohesion and quality standards across time zones and disciplines. Our team has a strong in-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in San Francisco. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design. Every day. Own creative output for Gamma's highest-visibility moments, from product launches and brand campaigns to enterprise sales materials — set the quality bar by producing the work, not just approving it - Manage and elevate a distributed design team while collaborating with marketers on campaigns and brand initiatives. Hire new designers as the team grows - Drive AI-first creative production by building repeatable workflows for ideation, asset production, and iteration across your team - Own Gamma's brand identity and visual systems across every surface: marketing, social, events, and sales collateral to scale the brand from prosumer delight to B2B credibility - Develop creative strategies that serve Gamma's full audience spectrum, from individual creators to Fortune 100 decision-makers, adapting tone and visual approach while keeping the brand cohesive - Build frameworks that let regional teams produce on-brand work at speed, and lead localized creative for key markets across AMER, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 8+ years of creative experience at an agency or in-house brand-forward company, with a portfolio showing hands-on design craft and strategic brand thinking - Active, daily fluency with AI creative tools and a clear point of view on how they transform creative production - Experience managing distributed creative teams and collaborating cross-functionally with marketers, PMs, and product designers - Proven ability to hire and develop creative talent — you know what great looks like and can attract designers who raise the bar - Experience building brand creative across segments, from self-serve and SMB to enterprise, with an understanding of how tone and visual language flex for different buyers - A global perspective on design, with experience building localized creative programs or working with international audiences COMPENSATION RANGE: The base salary for this full-time position, which spans multiple internal levels depending on qualifications, ranges between $250K - $300K plus benefits & equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to experience and expertise in the requirements listed above. If you're interested in this role but you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway! We're always excited about meeting great people.

hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:6004f978-5977-44c1-a43.title: Sales Executive (full cycle) - SMB
hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:6004f978-5977-44c1-a43.description: 🚀 Filiz est une start-up innovante de la EdTech, en pleine croissance et dans un contexte international à venir, qui simplifie et automatise les démarches administratives et financières liées aux contrats d’alternance et de stage. Grâce à notre plateforme 100% en ligne (SaaS), nous facilitons la vie des écoles, des entreprises et des étudiants en rendant les processus plus fluides, rapides et collaboratifs. Fini la paperasse, finis les allers-retours interminables : tout se fait en quelques clics, de manière flexible, automatisée et centralisée. ⚡️ Filiz est accompagnée par Hexa Scale, une nouvelle initiative lancée par Hexa (ex-eFounders) - le startup studio à l’origine de Aircall, Spendesk, et Front. Hexa Scale accompagne des entreprises SaaS B2B ambitieuses ayant de la traction, pour les aider à passer à l’échelle supérieure grâce à des investissements et un accompagnement opérationnel sur mesure. 💥 Filiz a déjà doublé son ARR deux années de suite, en s’appuyant presque exclusivement sur l’inbound et le bouche-à-oreille. La machine Marketing tourne. L'équipe Sales se structure. C'est le bon moment pour rejoindre et performer. 🎯 Ta mission Tu rejoins une équipe Sales naissante de 2 personnes : Elsa, notre Head of Sales et Eva, Sales full cycle, dans un contexte où les bases sont posées et les leads arrivent. Ton rôle : faire tourner un cycle de vente complet sur du SMB, avec vélocité et précision dans un marché qui répond. Pas question de tout construire de zéro. Il s'agit d'exécuter, itérer et performer sur de l'inbound bien qualifié et de l'outbound que tu pilotes pour compléter ton pipe. 💯 Responsabilités 1. Gérer ton pipe de A à Z - Traiter les leads entrants générés par le marketing avec réactivité et méthode - Construire et alimenter ta partie outbound (environ 2/3 de ton pipe) : identification, qualification, approche des écoles cibles - Piloter tes opportunités avec rigueur, du premier contact à la signature 2. Closer avec empathie et efficacité - Mener les discovery et démos, gérer les objections, conclure sur des cycles courts, avec cadence - Maintenir une haute vélocité sans sacrifier la qualité de la relation - Travailler en proximité avec la Head of Sales pour affiner les approches et partager les bonnes pratiques 3. Développer le revenu au-delà du closing - Identifier et activer les opportunités d'upsell au sein de ton portefeuille client (nouveaux modules, montée en gamme) - Collaborer avec le marketing et le Customer Success pour maximiser l'expansion revenue 4. Contribuer à la structuration commerciale - Documenter les pitchs gagnants, les objections récurrentes, les séquences qui fonctionnent - Participer à l'enrichissement du Sales Playbook dans une équipe qui se structure sans repartir de zéro 🤩 Profil recherché - 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en ventes B2B SaaS, sur des cycles complets (prospection → closing) - Tu es à l'aise sur du SMB : tu sais gérer le volume, maintenir la cadence et closer sans t'éterniser - Tu es autonome et organisé·e, capable de jongler entre inbound et outbound sans perdre le fil - Tu closes avec méthode et empathie, sans bullshit, sans pression inutile - Tu maîtrises les outils modernes (CRM, automatisation, stack outbound) - Tu aimes évoluer dans un environnement en structuration, sans avoir besoin que tout soit déjà parfait Bonus appréciés : - Une expérience sur des comptes grands groupes ou ETI en complément du SMB - Une expérience de vente sur un autre marché européen (Belgique, Espagne, Italie…) - Une connaissance du secteur EdTech ou des CFA / organismes de formation 🗺️ Poste basé à Paris, en télétravail partiel, dans une équipe majoritairement Full Remote. ⚙️ Process - Appel d’introduction avec l’équipe Talent (30min) - Entretien métier avec Elsa - Head of Revenue (1h) - Entretien avec Maxime - Founder & CEO (45min) - Étude de cas (1h) - Prises de références
